name: XALute
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "The phase 3 test of the first T-cell engager for prostate cancer."
fields.after: "XALute is the phase 3 test of the first T-cell engager for prostate cancer."

fields.before: "n≈675, randomised 2:1, OS primary; active and no longer recruiting as of May 2026. Companion XALience trial tests xaluritamig + abiraterone in chemo-naive mCRPC."
fields.after: "XALute randomises about 675 men 2:1 with OS as the primary endpoint; it was active and no longer recruiting in May 2026. The companion XALience trial tests xaluritamig + abiraterone in chemo-naive mCRPC."
